plain: According to the podcast host Jesse Michels, a physicist named Hal Puthoff says President George W. Bush and his vice president, Dick Cheney, were very interested in disclosure, meaning telling the public what the government knows about UFOs. Puthoff says Bush's national security adviser, Stephen Hadley, ran a review of what disclosure would look like, and another researcher says Puthoff himself was asked to take part. In one telling the panel decided disclosure was not worth it. If true, it would mean a US president seriously weighed revealing the secret and chose not to.
